source_snapshot.items: All E1.s NVMe LED Check - Hard drive read/write
source_snapshot.procedure: Insert an E1.S NVMe into a backplane slot, run FIO, observe its activity LED, and collect photos/logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Use system LED specification; LED flickers green during drive read/write operations.
source_snapshot.script: No Master script; 10 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; only proposes lsblk/nvme list through insecure SSH, falsely claims no risk and omits both FIO and physical flicker evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; requires stable bay/namespace identity, destructive-write protection, exact FIO recipe, qualified insertion and direct activity-LED evidence.

old_problem: The historical review left the clear FIO-plus-activity-LED case pending for its bay/target, workload and visual oracle. DeepSeek's read-only inventory omitted the defining stimulus and visible result and ignored write/data risk.
disposition_reason: The source purpose, method and safety boundary are clear. ED-03/04/09/10/20 permit bay/namespace identity, disposable or bounded target, FIO geometry and LED cadence as signed runtime parameters while strictly excluding OS, mounted, swap, LVM, RAID, device-mapper, multipath and valuable data. Qualified operator insertion and video are combined with one approved FIO execution and pre/post health. Missing target/recipe blocks execution, not review; FIO and real flicker evidence remain mandatory.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2215, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2216 / Wistron-HW-00491-V002 / 8208e273a3345a70 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Define `All E1.s` as a signed bay/population matrix and bind bay/slot/controller, drive serial/model/firmware and namespace NGUID/EUI/UUID.
Operator uses the approved hot-plug or powered-down ESD insertion procedure; automation never handles hardware.
Before any write, prove stable target identity, disposable/backup or bounded-file scope and exclusion from OS/boot/mount/swap/LVM/RAID/dm/multipath/open holders.
Bind exact FIO filename/device, rw mix/directions, ioengine, block size, depth/jobs, size/range, runtime and verify/cleanup; execute once only after separate write authorization.
Timestamped video must show the exact bay green activity flicker causally overlapping measured FIO bytes/IOPS; enumeration or steady power LED cannot substitute.
Preserve logs and pre/post SMART/NVMe health; abort on wrong target, holder drift, I/O/media error, reset/disappearance, thermal or physical/LED anomaly without retry.
No insertion, inventory query, FIO read/write, photo/video, retry, cleanup, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Protected per-bay E1.S FIO read/write and timestamped green activity-LED correlation
test_case.purpose: Verify actual approved read/write traffic reaches the correctly mapped E1.S target and causes the exact bay activity indicator to flicker green, without data, endurance, media, controller, backplane or platform error.
required_package: Signed `All E1.s` bay/population and bay/controller/drive/namespace stable-ID map
Approved hot-plug or powered-down insertion/removal and ESD procedure
Disposable namespace or bounded file target with backup and complete active-stack/holder exclusions
Exact FIO target, directions/mix, ioengine, block size, depth/jobs, size/range, runtime and verify/cleanup
Green-flicker cadence/visibility oracle, write/endurance/health/thermal aborts and final state
test_case.test_command: For each signed bay, operator performs the approved insertion once. Read-only preflight matches bay, serial and namespace stable IDs, proves disposable/bounded scope and excludes OS/boot/mount/swap/LVM/RAID/dm/multipath/open holders, then preserves SMART/error/endurance baseline. After separate destructive-write authorization, run the exact signed FIO job once while timestamped operator video records the mapped bay LED. Preserve full FIO stdout/stderr/exit, bytes/IOPS/latency/timestamps and correlate the active interval with green flicker; collect post-health and execute only signed cleanup/final-state steps.
test_case.expected_result: The exact approved target alone receives the full signed read/write workload; FIO verification and limits pass; timestamped real visual evidence shows green activity flicker on the correct bay during I/O; no holder/data, endurance, media, reset, thermal, backplane or platform anomaly occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when stable bay/namespace identity, active-stack exclusions, approved FIO result, synchronized green-flicker evidence and pre/post health all match. Wrong/held target, unauthorized range, FIO/verify failure, absent/wrong LED behavior, reset/media/error/health/thermal breach or cleanup failure is FAIL. Missing target/recipe/LED oracle is BLOCKED at execution; inventory, steady green or uncorrelated flicker cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until stable target, disposable/backup/bounded scope, all active-stack exclusions, exact FIO job, LED oracle, recovery and separate write approval are signed.
Never infer `/dev/nvme*` by order; require bay/BDF/serial plus namespace NGUID/EUI/UUID agreement before any I/O.
Protect OS, boot, mounted, swap, LVM, RAID, device-mapper, multipath and valuable data; no unapproved raw writes, format/sanitize or stack alteration.
Stop once on identity/holder drift, I/O/media/verify error, reset/disappearance, thermal/health or physical/LED anomaly; no automatic FIO or insertion retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and signed bay/drive/namespace stable-ID matrix
Insertion approval plus disposable/bounded target, backup and active-stack/holder exclusion proof
Exact FIO job file/hash and separate destructive-write authorization
Complete FIO stdout/stderr/exit, bytes/IOPS/latency and timestamps for approved directions
Per-bay video/photo proving green flicker synchronized with I/O and correct drive identity
Pre/post NVMe health/error/endurance, preserved host/BMC/SEL/AER, cleanup/recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On any target, holder, I/O, media, reset, thermal/health or LED anomaly, stop FIO once and preserve all evidence; never rerun. Keep the target isolated and have the storage/hardware owner perform signed cleanup or restore after verifying OS/array safety. Operator handles any removal through the approved service procedure; automation does not format, sanitize, detach, restore or power-cycle.

source_conflict.reason: The unique source consistently requires FIO plus green activity flicker. DeepSeek's enumeration-only substitution is corrected as incomplete review, not a source conflict.
